subject: Marketplace portal: clarifying brand footnote and support coverage
messages:
From: Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace@aws-partner.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Claudia Ruiz <claudia@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Portal listing: request to clarify support SLA footnote and branding

Hi Jonas,

During our final QC pass for Acme Health's co-sell listing we noticed two items that need vendor confirmation before publication:

1) A small brand footnote appears under the product description that mentions "Third-party monitoring not included." Legal wants to confirm whether that phrasing is vendor-provided or platform-inserted. If it's vendor text, we need a signed confirmation.

2) The support hours on the portal show a regional support window (Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm PT) but Acme's listing claims 24/7 enterprise support. Marketplace policy requires the public portal to reflect vendor-supported hours or an explicit escalation path.

Can Redwood confirm:
- Whether the footnote is content you supplied and whether you can provide the originating copy.
- A support-hours matrix or a short public-friendly line (one sentence) that we can display that conforms to marketplace policy.

If we don't get clarification by EOD Friday we'll have to place a temporary "awaiting confirmation" flag on the listing.

Thanks,
– Marketplace Listing Team

[attachment: portal-edit-screenshot.png]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Claudia Ruiz <claudia@acmehealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal listing: request to clarify support SLA footnote and branding

Hi — thanks for the heads-up.

Quick answers:
- The footnote was not inserted by us; looks like the marketplace build pipeline inserted a generic liability note when we left the optional "support_exclusions" field blank. We'll send the exact source copy shortly.
- Redwood honors the 24/7 enterprise support claim for Acme (they are on a Dedicated contract). We do provide monitoring and SRE on-call for that tier. For public display we can provide this line: "24/7 enterprise support with prioritized on-call response; see Support Hours & Escalation matrix."

Attaching a proposed support-hours matrix (internal CSV) and the latest brand guidelines (redwood_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf) for any copy edits. Kim — can you confirm the legal-safe public phrasing for the footnote and whether we should ask the marketplace to remove the pipeline-inserted clause?

Action items:
- We need the marketplace to remove the auto-inserted footnote or replace it with vendor-submitted copy.
- Publish the one-line public support phrase and link to the escalation doc.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[attachments: redwood_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf, support-hours-matrix.csv]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace@aws-partner.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal listing: request to clarify support SLA footnote and branding

Thanks, Jonas. Reading into the marketplace policy (see excerpt below), the portal copy must not imply vendor coverage beyond what is contractually committed. For Dedicated Acme we can do 24/7 support language but must include the escalation path and any regional caveats. Suggested public line: "24/7 enterprise support (global) for Dedicated customers; see escalation contacts for regional operations."

Marketplace policy excerpt: 
- Public-facing support claims must match vendor documentation
- If an automated pipeline adds exclusions, vendor must approve any edits

I recommend we:
- Provide the suggested one-liner above and a short footnote that points to the contract: "Support commitments documented in customer contract; response SLA varies by plan."
- Request that the marketplace remove the generic "Third-party monitoring not included" clause — it conflicts with our Dedicated SRE offering for Acme. If they decline, we ask for a clarification line.

Marissa — can you help coordinate with the Acme buyer (Claudia) if they need to sign off on any marketplace-visible phrasing? Also loop legal if they want to see the public line before we push it.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Aug 30, 2028 at 11:02 AM jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> > Attaching a proposed support-hours matrix (internal CSV) and the latest brand guidelines.
> >
> > [attachments: redwood_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf, support-hours-matrix.csv]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claudia Ruiz <claudia@acmehealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace@aws-partner.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Sep 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal listing: request to clarify support SLA footnote and branding

Hi Claudia — looping you in to confirm you're happy with the public phrasing. Per Kimberly's suggestion we propose the following portal copy: 

Headline: "24/7 enterprise support (global)"
Footnote (one line): "Support commitments are documented in customer contracts; response times vary by plan and region."

If that wording looks good to you, we'll ask Marketplace to swap the pipeline-inserted clause for the vendor-provided line and publish the support-hours matrix as a linked doc (non-public CSV). If you prefer a stronger legal-safe phrasing we can capture that.

Claudia replied (inline):
> Looks good to me — prefer the concise headline. I don't need to sign anything else for the vendor-facing copy. Please confirm the marketplace will remove their auto-inserted note.

Next steps (agreed):
- I'll file a request with Marketplace to replace the pipeline footnote with our vendor text and attach the brand guidelines for logo placement.
- Jonas to follow up on the portal screenshot once the change is live.
- Kim to keep a short note in the contract repository confirming phrasing aligns with the Dedicated SOW.

Thanks everyone — moving to Done on my side once Marketplace confirms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Marketing
Redwood Inference
